name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
ministryOrDepartment: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
shortDescription: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet daily expenses while pursuing higher studies.
benefitAmount: Rs 12,000 per annum for UG (1st-3rd year), Rs 20,000 per annum for PG

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
ministryOrDepartment: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
shortDescription: Empowering young women pursuing technical diploma or degree education in AICTE approved institutions.
benefitAmount: Rs 50,000 per annum for every year of study
requiredDocuments: Admission letter to AICTE approved Degree/Diploma course

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministryOrDepartment: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
shortDescription: Comprehensive financial support including tuition fee and maintenance allowance for SC students studying post-matriculation.
benefitAmount: 100% Tuition fee waiver + Rs 4,000 to Rs 13,500 annual maintenance

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
ministryOrDepartment: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
shortDescription: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families.
benefitAmount: Rs 6,000 per year (Direct Bank Transfer in 3 tranches)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
ministryOrDepartment: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
shortDescription: Free industry-relevant skill training, NSQF certification, and placement assistance for Indian youth seeking employment.
benefitAmount: 100% Free Government Certification Training + Rs 8,000 stipend support

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti (EBC Scheme)
ministryOrDepartment: Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra
shortDescription: 50% tuition and exam fee reimbursement for economically backward class students enrolled in approved technical and professional courses.

name: Karnataka Vidyasiri (Food & Accommodation) Scholarship Scheme
ministryOrDepartment: Department of Backward Classes Welfare, Government of Karnataka
shortDescription: Monthly financial stipend of Rs 1,500 towards food and hostel accommodation for rural backward class students in Karnataka.
benefitAmount: Rs 1,500 per month (Rs 15,000 per academic year)

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
shortDescription: Monthly non-contributory pension for senior citizens living below the poverty line.
benefitAmount: Rs 1,000 to Rs 2,500 monthly pension (Central + State share)
requiredDocuments: Age Proof / Birth Certificate / Voter ID
